# Noche menu bar, transcribed by hand from live-ui.md section 9 (menu and shortcut inventory), the reference app's name replaced by Noche.
# Line: <menu path>|<title>|<key>|<modifiers>|<enabled in a one-tab window>   ("---" is a separator, "bar" the top level)
# Key: the US-layout key as AppKit stores it ("+" for Zoom In, ":" for Cmd+:); modifiers in the order ctrl+opt+shift+cmd.
# Enabled: 1, 0, r (nil-targeted: the responder chain decides, so it is not asserted; a hidden window is never key) or e (equals the engine's CanExecute for the command; Task Manager).
# Items of a later milestone are present and 0. Layout glyph keys of section 1 are the US keys (Cmd+[ and Cmd+] for Go Back and Go Forward).
# Omitted on purpose (no Noche counterpart, design section 3): the reference's invite item, plan label, Upgrade Plan..., Sign Out, Chat with Support,
#   Video Tour, Status, Record Performance Issue..., the per-profile Window items (profiles arrive in M1.7), the installed-extensions list
#   and the Recent Bookmarks entries (dynamic). Submenus of Move to Group, Move to Profile, Move to Window and Bookmarks Bar are dynamic: the items stand alone (Move to Group is a live submenu, listed as disabled in a window with no group: its groups, under a disabled PINNED header, are added when it opens).
# Window items the system adds (Fill, Center, Move & Resize, Full Screen Tile, Move to display, the window list) carry no Noche mark and are skipped.
